item.title: Report: GTA 6 Map Leaks via Collector's Box Sold Early at Selfridges UK
item.description: A Grand Theft Auto VI Collector's Edition box was reportedly sold early at a Selfridges store in Manchester, revealing the game's official map ahead of the November 19 release. Photos shared on social media show the folded map displaying new location names such as Southwind and Pelican Valley.

item.description: The Guardian's Keza MacDonald toured Rockstar North and reported new gameplay details for Grand Theft Auto VI, including protagonist Jason Duval eating a hot dog while holding a beer and a donut, realistic liquid physics when running with a six-pack, and insights into the studio's Miami research tri

item.title: GTA Online Event Week: Last One Before GTA 6 (Nov 12-18)
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports the November 12-18 GTA Online event week features Kortz Center Heist rewards, double Priority File payouts, casino prizes, test rides and dealer offers.

item.title: Rockstar Games Confirms New GTA VI Footage Shared by Miami Social Account
item.description: Rockstar Games reposted a 20-second Grand Theft Auto VI clip from the Miami-based Instagram account Only In Dade, confirming its authenticity. The footage shows Vice City streets, protagonists Jason and Lucia, high NPC density, and vehicles matching recent Rockstar marketing events.

item.title: Rockstar Games Launcher Adds Revamped Chat Overlay with Discord Integration and Streamer Mode
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports that Rockstar Games has released a new update for the Rockstar Games Launcher (RGL), introducing a completely reworked chat overlay. According to the publication, the update includes updated visual designs, new social and achievement functionality, and full controller support.

item.title: Rockstar Confirms Ongoing GTA Online Support After GTA 6 Launch
item.description: Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick confirmed that Rockstar Games will continue supporting GTA Online with new content and events well after GTA 6 launches, alongside massive sales milestones for GTA V and the series.

item.title: GTA 6 Pop‑up Store Opens in London, Selling Exclusive Merch
item.description: Rockstar Games partners with Selfridges for a limited‑time GTA 6 pop‑up in London, selling bags, jackets and more. The store runs Nov 9‑28, with £2,500 jacket and strict purchase limits.

item.title: GTA 6 Box Copies Begin Arriving Early with Online Feature and New Screenshots
item.description: Physical GTA 6 copies are arriving at retailers November 12, with a 230GB install size and an online functions icon, while new screenshots showcase Lucia, Jason and a plane.

item.title: New GTA6 Screenshots Compare Real-Life Cars to In-Game Vehicles
item.description: New Grand Theft Auto VI screenshots have been released with side-by-side comparisons of real-life vehicles and in-game models, featuring West Coast Customs recreations of iconic GTA cars and Rockstar's 'Launch Gallery' drop ahead of the November 19, 2026 launch.

item.description: GTA+ members receive a host of new incentives for November 2026, including the exclusive Grotti Itali RSX sports car, fresh Chameleon paints, extra aircraft storage slots, and discounted test‑drive vehicles at the members‑only Vinewood Car Club. item.title: GTA 6 Pre-Load Date, Release Time & Physical Map Confirmed
item.description: Rockstar Games has officially confirmed the GTA 6 pre-load schedule, install size, and release details. Pre-loading begins November 10 for digital editions, with a 212 GB install size required. The game will release at midnight local time on November 19, and a physical map will be included.

item.title: Report: GTA 6 Buying Guide: Console Costs, Editions, and Digital-Only Release Detailed by GameSpot
item.description: GameSpot publishes a buying guide for GTA 6's November 19 release, outlining console prices, edition details, 201GB file size, preloading start date, and digital-only distribution.

item.title: GTA Online Halloween Weather Returns with Green Filter; Workaround Discovered
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports that GTA Online's Halloween weather has returned for 2026, applying a green-orange filter from 19:00 to 7:30 in-game time. Players have found a temporary workaround using apartments to disable the filter, and green-tint glasses in first-person reduce the effect.

item.title: Free Grotti Turismo Omaggio and Rockstar Motorsport Livery Via GTA Online Twitch Drops
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports that Rockstar Games and Twitch are offering GTA Online players a free Grotti Turismo Omaggio supercar and Rockstar Motorsport livery via Twitch Drops from October 30 through November 1, 2026.

item.title: GTA Online Halloween Event Ends: Final Week Bonuses (October 29–November 4)
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports the conclusion of GTA Online's month-long Halloween event with the weekly update for October 29–November 4, 2026. item.title: GTA 6 Original Score Soundtrack Announced, Vinyl Pre-Orders Go Live
item.description: Rockstar Games announces the GTA 6 Original Score composed by Justice, with vinyl and CD pre-orders live ahead of the December 2026 release.

item.title: Report: GTA 6 Gameplay Shown in New South Park Episode, RockstarINTEL Reports
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports that official Grand Theft Auto VI gameplay aired during a new South Park episode, featuring Jason and Lucia in Vice City and a beach scene with dense NPCs.

item.title: Rockstar Games Pays About $3.9 Million for GTA 6 Miami Marketing Deal
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports Rockstar Games and Miami-Dade County finalized a roughly $3.9 million GTA 6 marketing agreement for Vice City branding at Miami International Airport, PortMiami, and county traffic cabinets.

item.title: GTA 6 File Size Revealed: 210GB on PS5, Preload Starts November 12
item.description: GameSpot reports that the PlayStation 5 standard edition of Grand Theft Auto VI will occupy 210GB of storage, according to data from the PlayStation Game Size Twitter account. item.title: GTA 6 Developers to Vote on Union Recognition
item.description: Rockstar Games UK staff are set to vote on union recognition during the GTA 6 launch, with voting scheduled from November 12 to 26.

item.title: GTA 6 Early Review Access Confirmed by Rockstar Insider
item.description: RockstarINTEL reports that review codes for Grand Theft Auto VI have been distributed to reviewers, with public reviews scheduled for November 18th, one day before launch.

item.title: Report: GTA 6: Gameplay, Trailers, Features & Everything We Know (Updated October 2026)
item.description: Beebom published an updated October 2026 overview of Grand Theft Auto 6 covering gameplay, trailers, and features. The RSS listing does not include specific article details.

item.description: Gamespot reports that Rockstar Games has partnered with Skinny Louie to transform select Florida locations into Burger Shot restaurants promoting GTA 6, with menus and campaigns running through December 31. item.title: Report: PureGym Shares Thumb Workouts to Prepare for GTA VI Launch
item.description: GameSpot reports PureGym shared three thumb exercises from trainer David Hope to help players warm up before Grand Theft Auto VI releases on November 19, alongside related launch-day projections and themed food at Miami's Kaseya Center.
